item.description: Lucid Group Inc. (NASDAQ:LCID) is cutting 12% of its global workforce as the luxury EV maker moves to streamline operations and push closer to profitability after a turbulent year. item.title: Elon Musk's Tesla Must Pay $243 Milllion In 2019 Fatal Autopilot Crash As Judge Says Evidence 'More Than Supports' Liability
item.description: A federal judge in Miami refused to overturn a $243 million jury verdict against Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) on Friday, over a 2019 fatal crash in Florida involving the EV maker’s Autopilot system.
